    • Method Detail

      • communicationElement

        @PublishedMethod
ISelectedCommunicationElement communicationElement(@Nonnull
                                                                     java.lang.String... communicationElementName)
        communicationElement(String...) allows to select an ICommunicationElement and to do further operations on it, e.g. performing a data mapping. For complex communication elements also the children can be selected. In such case the first communicationElementName has to be the name of the root element.
        Parameters:
        communicationElementName - The fully qualified name of the communication elements. For complex elements, start at the root element. For non-complex communication elements, only one communicationElementName is allowed. (E.g. "MyComponent.MyPort.MyDataElement1".)
        Returns:
        the ISelectedCommunicationElement

      • communicationElements

        @PublishedMethod
ISelectedCommunicationElements communicationElements(@Nonnull
                                                                       java.util.List<ICommunicationElement> communicationElements)
        communicationElements(List) wraps ICommunicationElements to do further operations on them, e.g. map them to system signals.
        Parameters:
        communicationElements - A list of communication elements on which further operations should be performed. The order can be relevant for further operations. Children of complex communication elements (arrays and records) should be inserted directly after the parent. For operation communication elements there are always two communication elements (for call and return), they should be inserted one directly after the other.
        Returns:
        the ISelectedCommunicationElements

      • componentPort

        @PublishedMethod
ISelectedComponentPort componentPort(@Nonnull
                                                       java.lang.String componentName,
                                                       @Nonnull
                                                       java.lang.String portName)
        componentPort(String, String) allows to select an IComponentPort and to do further operations on it, e.g. connecting the port to another port.
        Parameters:
        componentName - The name of the component whose component port should be selected. In case of a delegation port use 'COMPOSITIONTYPE'.
        portName - The name of the port that should be selected.
        Returns:
        the ISelectedComponentPort

        Parameters:

      • getModelAbstractionsForMdfObjects

        @PublishedMethod
java.util.Collection<? extends IModelAbstraction> getModelAbstractionsForMdfObjects(java.util.Collection<IModelObject> mdfObjects)
        getModelAbstractionsForMdfObjects(Collection) is a method for an arbitrary access to all model abstractions which correspond to the given collection of MDF objects.

        If a given MDF object is removed or not visible for the currently active variant view it will be ignored.

        The method may determine IModelAbstractions which are not yet part of the published Automation Interface. Nevertheless using the common methods in IModelAbstraction is allowed.

        Parameters:
        mdfObjects - The MDF objects for which model abstractions should be retrieved.
        Returns:
        A collection of model abstraction which represent the given MDF objects.
